title: CSB Bancorp, Inc. Declares Third Quarter Cash Dividend
summary: MILLERSBURG, Ohio, August 26, 2026--CSB Bancorp, Inc., (OTCID: CSBB) announced that the Company’s Board of Directors has declared a third quarter cash dividend of $0.45 per share on its common stock, payable September 22, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 8, 2026. The dividend represents a $0.02 increase in the linked quarterly cash dividend and a $0.04 increase over the prior year third quarter dividend.
